name: endzoneapi
description: EndzoneAPI brings NFL football data into ChatGPT and Codex with read-only tools and workflow skills: standings, schedules and results, player stats and leaders, injuries, depth charts, snap counts, play-by-play, advanced stats, sportsbook odds, alternate lines and player prop lines. Sign in with your EndzoneAPI account.

interface.longDescription:
EndzoneAPI connects ChatGPT and Codex to NFL football data from EndzoneAPI. It covers the NFL with play-by-play, EPA, snap counts, depth charts and injuries, plus college football.

Ask for standings, schedules and results, player stats and leaders, injuries, depth charts, snap counts, play-by-play, advanced stats, sportsbook odds, alternate lines and player prop lines. The plugin looks the answer up with read-only tools and reports what the data says, including the season, date and source of each number.

The first time you use it, you sign in with your EndzoneAPI account.

Limits: EndzoneAPI is read-only. It cannot place wagers, accept or track bets, or edit your account. Odds and prop lines are shown as information about the market, not as advice. Data comes from public sources and the EndzoneAPI pipeline and is not guaranteed to be error-free or current to the minute, so do not rely on it as the sole basis for financial decisions. Ratings shown are EndzoneAPI's own Elo-style ratings, not official rankings. Not affiliated with the NFL or any team.

Bundled skills teach the model how to choose the right tool for a question and how to explain results.
capabilities: Look up NFL teams, players and games
Read play-by-play, EPA and advanced stats
Read injuries, depth charts and snap counts
Read sportsbook odds and prop lines (information only)
defaultPrompt: Show the 2025 NFL AFC East standings.
Who led the NFL in passing yards in 2025?
What was the Bills' 2025 regular season record?

positive.prompt: Show the 2025 NFL AFC East standings.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the four AFC East teams: New England 14-3, Buffalo 12-5, Miami 7-10, New York Jets 3-14, with division and conference ranks.

positive.prompt: Find Josh Allen, the Bills quarterback, and give me his 2025 season stats.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Josh Allen (player id 00-0034857, QB, Buffalo, #17), then returns his 2025 totals: 16 games, 319 of 460 passing for 3,668 yards, 25 touchdowns and 10 interceptions, plus 579 rushing yards.

positive.prompt: Give me the game details for the Ravens at Bills game in Week 1 of 2025.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves game id 2025_01_BAL_BUF and returns the result: Baltimore 40, Buffalo 41 on 2025-09-07, with team stats and officials.

positive.prompt: Who led the NFL in passing yards in 2025?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the top passers: Matthew Stafford (LA) 4,707 yards, Jared Goff (DET) 4,564, Dak Prescott (DAL) 4,552.

positive.prompt: What was the Bills' 2025 regular season record, points scored and points allowed?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Buffalo's 2025 regular season: 12-5, 481 points for, 365 against, point differential +116, with home and away splits.

negative.description: Place a wager: wagering is not supported
negative.prompt: Place a $50 bet on the Bills to win tonight.
Show me the current NHL standings.

negative.description: Account and billing change: not supported
negative.prompt: Buy 10,000 more credits and upgrade my plan to the highest tier.

review.commerce_description: EndzoneAPI does not sell anything through ChatGPT. The plugin is read-only: it has no checkout, purchase, subscription or credit top-up flow.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Read-only NFL football data tools with OAuth sign-in and 14 workflow skills.
